coop.name: Fresh egg breakfasts
coop.description: Delicious Breakfast at Hillside Guest house: fresh eggs dishes
coop.author: Khachatur Martirosyan
texts: An egg eaten in the morning saturates the human body with a supply of protein and essential amino acids for the whole day. There are more than two dozen recipes for cooking eggs. In addition, this natural product is easily digested and creates a feeling of satiety.
Our menu can offer you eggs Benedict, omelet, scrambled eggs, boiled eggs, scrambled eggs with basturma, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, etc.
We offer super fresh product straight from the roost! So how do we go about doing this? Easily. Our guesthouse has its own chicken farm.
Did you have breakfast? Well. Let's take a walk around the beautiful ancient city of Yerevan!

mir.name: Mir payment system
mir.description: What currency do you need for travel in Armenia?
mir.author: Khachatur Martirosyan
texts: For a trip to Armenia, you can take with you any desired currency. You can easily exchange dollars, euros and rubles for drams at any bank branch or exchange office. You can always find them nearby.

What about credit cards? Most stores accept popular payment systems like MasterCard, Visa, and Maestro. Albeit, there are some difficulties with the Russian payment system MIR according to Swift-related sanctions. However, it is not always possible to withdraw money from credit cards. Therefore, it would be a good idea to bring cash with you to Armenia. This is the best option.
Hillside Guest House accepts payment for the room in any way convenient for the guest.

texts: From November 1, 2022 to February 28, 2023 our guesthouse Hillside offers significant discounts on accommodation rooms. During this period, you can book a room for 15% cheaper from the original price. Discount on accommodation in the center of Yerevan is great news for travelers!
